text: The Los Angeles Dodgers were bought in 2012 by the private investor group operating as Guggenheim Baseball Management (including Mark Walter, Todd Boehly, Peter Guber, Magic Johnson and Bobby Patton) -- a privately held ownership group, not a company with public institutional or retail shareholders.

source.name: MLB article on Dodgers sale to Guggenheim
source.quote: The investor group includes Mandalay Entertainment chairman Peter Guber, Guggenheim Partners president Todd Boehly and Texas energy investor Bobby Patton.
